newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU opens in-depth probe into BT/MCI merger.
newsitem.headline: EU opens in-depth probe into BT/MCI merger.

text.p: The European Commission has opened an in-depth probe into the $20 billion merger between British Telecommunications Plc and MCI Communications Corp, an industry source said on Thursday.
"It's been confirmed, it's going to phase two," the source, who asked not to be named, told Reuters.

The widely trailed launch of a full probe into the alliance between the two telecommunications giants was submitted to the Commission for clearance in December under EU merger rules which ban creation or strengthening of dominant positions.

Thursday was the deadline for the EU executive to decide whether to clear the deal after its preliminary inquiry or launch an in-depth probe if it was worried about the impact on fair competition in Europe.

Commission inquiries, which could last up to four months, seem to pose little danger for the alliance itself, which still faces its main regulatory challenge on the other side of the Atlantic, industry sources and anti-trust lawyers have said.
U.S. telecoms giant AT&T has particularly demanded that the approval of the operation be made subject to competitive safeguards and commitments regarding fair pricing and equal access to phone lines.
